directAnswer.en: This is masonry, blockwork or a render coat. The material is mortar or a fine coat, not a structural stone pipeline. Open this row when the spray job has no 380 V supply. Power is printed as 28/32 HP, particle ≤6 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine at diesel engine 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 80 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm and 480 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine, which prints 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm and 295 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

heading.en: What the mortar coat has to match

body.en: This is masonry, blockwork or a render coat. The material is mortar or a fine coat, not a structural stone pipeline. Open this row when the spray job has no 380 V supply. Power is printed as 28/32 HP, particle ≤6 mm. The published Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine row is diesel engine 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 80 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm and 480 kg.
body.zh: 这是砌体、砌块或罩面。材料是砂浆或薄涂层，不是结构石子管路。喷涂作业没有 380V 时打开这一行。动力印的是 28/32 HP，粒径 ≤6 mm。已公布的柴油混凝土喷涂机是柴油机 28/32 HP、5 m³/h、8 MPa、水平 80 m / 垂直 40 m、管径 38/51 mm、粒径 ≤6 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、外形 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm、480 kg。

heading.en: Do not treat it as the neighbouring machine
heading.zh: 不要把它当成相邻的那一台

body.en: Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine prints 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm and 295 kg. The shared job site in the photograph does not merge the two tables. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
body.zh: 液压混凝土喷涂机印的是380V、全铜双电机 7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h、8 MPa、水平 100 m / 垂直 50 m、管径 38/51 mm、粒径 ≤8 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、外形 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm、295 kg。照片里的同类现场不能把两张表并成一张。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

body.en: Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the material, the largest particle, the sand-cement ratio, the hose length you measured, and whether the site can supply the printed power. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请把材料、最大粒径、砂灰比、量到的软管长度，以及现场能否按已印动力供电，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
